subject: Trial checkpoint: acceptance velocity & open risk register
messages:
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
To: Lara Jennings <lara@alphacorp.com>, AlphaCorp Procurement <procurement@alphacorp.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 22 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Trial checkpoint: acceptance velocity & open risk register

Hi Lara / team,

Quick weekly checkpoint on the mutual action plan for the AlphaCorp POC. Goal of this note is to summarize progress against the evaluation plan, call out blockers that are slowing acceptance velocity, and confirm owners for the next 10 business days.

Summary (TL;DR)
- Acceptance progress: 3 of 6 MAP milestones have experimental evidence in our eval harness; 1 milestone has partial results pending data refresh.
- Key blocker: secure test dataset delivery and Prod-like traffic replay (affects latency/throughput acceptance).
- Next milestone target: acceptance test run for "Throughput at 95th percentile" by 2027-07-02.

Open items and owners (short list)
1) Delivery of masked test dataset (AlphaCorp) — owner: Lara Jennings — needed by 2027-06-25.
2) Playback config for traffic replay (AlphaCorp + Proc) — owner: AlphaCorp Eng — needed by 2027-06-24.
3) Eval harness run + results upload (Redwood) — owner: Marissa Cole — target 2027-06-28.
4) Cost/quantization sensitivity run (Redwood) — owner: Rishi Malhotra — slot on 2027-06-26.

Attachments: I attached the updated MAP worksheet (AlphaCorp_MAP_v2.xlsx) with the milestone timeline and the eval_test_cases_202706.zip containing the current test cases and expected pass criteria.

Can you confirm the dataset delivery ETA and whether procurement needs anything to sign off on the dataset transfer? If delivery slips beyond 06-25 it will push the acceptance run into the following week and affect proposed close timelines.

I'll host a 30-min sync tomorrow to unblock dataset handoffs if that helps — propose 11:00am PT.

Thanks,
Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Sales Engineering, Redwood Inference
vivek@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0182

From: Lara Jennings <lara@alphacorp.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, AlphaCorp Procurement <procurement@alphacorp.com>
Date: Wed, 23 Jun 2027 10:02:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Trial checkpoint: acceptance velocity & open risk register

Vivek — thanks for the concise update. Quick answers and clarifications:

- Dataset: we have one legal review outstanding on the masked dataset export. Procurement expects that to be signed by end of day Friday 06/25; procurement has been looped in separately. If legal signs off earlier we can transfer earlier.
- Playback: Eng has the replay config but needs an access window to the staging traffic mirror. Can Redwood accept a timeboxed window next week (06/28-06/30) for a 2 hour run? We will coordinate with Prod Ops.
- Regarding the 95th percentile throughput run: can you confirm the sequence length profile and whether warm KV cache scenarios are required for acceptance? We want to make sure we don't generate false negatives.

Procurement note: @procurement, please confirm if you need a data processing addendum or a PO amendment for the masked dataset transfer.

Also — would appreciate Marissa calling out any tests likely to be re-run if the dataset refresh changes class distribution. That will help us assess rollback risk.

Cheers,
Lara
Lara Jennings
Director, Applied AI — AlphaCorp
lara@alphacorp.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Lara Jennings <lara@alphacorp.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, AlphaCorp Procurement <procurement@alphacorp.com>
Date: Thu, 24 Jun 2027 08:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Trial checkpoint: acceptance velocity & open risk register

Thanks — adding specifics from the eval side so everyone has visibility into the technical risk.

Acceptance plan notes:
- 95th percentile throughput run: we will run two profiles — (A) cold-start (empty KV cache) and (B) warm-cache (steady state). Both will use the sequence length histogram attached in the MAP worksheet. If AlphaCorp can provide the staging mirror window we will schedule both runs in the same contiguous slot.
- Tests most sensitive to dataset drift: NER extraction consistency and reranker precision. If class distribution shifts > 8% we will need to rebaseline the reranker and rerun precision/recall evaluation; that is likely a 2-business-day task.

Blockers and mitigations:
- Legal sign-off delay on dataset (external): critical path. Mitigation: we can run synthetic-stubbed runs with a small synthesized subset to validate plumbing and orchestration without real data; however, final acceptance requires real masked data.
- Staging access window (external): medium. Mitigation: Redwood can provision a traffic-capture adapter and run against a sampled export if timeboxed access is impossible. This has minor fidelity loss for tail latency.

Action items (owner / due)
- Lara: confirm dataset ETA and procurement status (06/25)
- AlphaCorp Ops: confirm staging access window for replay (06/24)
- Marissa: schedule eval harness slots and provisional synthetic run (06/26)
- Rishi: prepare quantization sensitivity matrix and cost delta forecast (06/26)
- Vivek: confirm executive checkpoint for revised close timeline if acceptance slips > 3 days (06/28)

I attached a short checklist to the MAP worksheet with test IDs that would require re-runs if distributions change. Attaching: eval_test_cases_202706.zip (contains test IDs and expected thresholds).

Best,
Marissa Cole
Principal Product Manager, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
To: Lara Jennings <lara@alphacorp.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, AlphaCorp Procurement <procurement@alphacorp.com>
Date: Thu, 24 Jun 2027 16:48:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Trial checkpoint: acceptance velocity & open risk register

Thanks all — quick read and next steps.

1) Lara / procurement: please reply to this thread with the legal sign-off status by EOD 06/25. If you prefer I can pull in my legal counterpart (cc'd on request) to accelerate.
2) Marissa / Rishi: please treat the 06/26 slots as provisional hard dates for synthetic runs and cost runs. If dataset arrives on 06/25 we will convert the synthetic slot to a final run on 06/26-06/28 as needed.
3) I've scheduled a 30-min unblock sync for 2027-06-23 11:00am PT (calendar invite sent) — if that time doesn't work I can move it.

Proposed rollback/contingency: if dataset slips beyond 06/25 we will push the target acceptance run to week of 07/05 and adjust the proposed close to the following two-week window. I will update the HubSpot deal record once we have confirmation.

Thanks again — appreciate the fast turnaround.

Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Sales Engineering, Redwood Inference
vivek@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0182
